data.name: San Diego Bay Parade of Lights on Triton Charters
data.headline: Sail with Triton Charters and watch the 56th annual Parade of Lights!
data.description:
# 56th Annual Parade of Lights #


The San Diego Bay Parade of Lights is a time-honored holiday tradition brought to San Diego by the boating community. Continuing its long-standing San Diego tradition, the 56th annual San Diego Bay Parade of Lights promises to dazzle and entertain bay front crowds during 2 evenings in December, December 13th and December 20th! Participants in this year’s highly anticipated holiday boat parade will decorate their boats to fit this year’s theme, "Liberty Lights the Bay - Cheers to 250 Years!"

Sip custom hot cocktails sold at our bar while we set sail for a 2.5-hour unforgettable experience aboard San Diego's largest Catamaran and enjoy watching the parade themed decorated boats cruise by!

meeting_point.address: 2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA US 92106

data.what_to_bring: Bring a blanket if you want to get cozy, a warm jacket, and even bring snacks!
data.cancellation_notes: Our cancellation policy requires a 72 hour notice. You may receive a full refund if you cancel at least 72 hours before the departure time. No refunds will be issued for cancellations made within 72 hours of the event start time. You have the option to reschedule to a regular ticketed charter but please note we cannot refund the price difference from the special event when rebooking.
data.booking_notes:
###Event Details:
Triton Charters Parade of Lights 🎄⛵️

Congratulations, you just booked your ticket for a 2.5-hour sail to experience an up close view of the annual Parade of Lights! Bring your blankets and get cozy with us to watch this year's 'Out of This World' themed boat parade! Full bar with hot drinks for purchase will be available! ☕️🍹

###Parking Directions:
Please click [HERE](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Shelter+Island+Dr+%26+Anchorage+Ln,+San+Diego,+CA+92106/@32.7205931,-117.2297802,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x80deaba20dd194af:0x814f40bb62025a8d!8m2!3d32.7205931!4d-117.2275915) for the map of where to park. For free parking, please park in the rear of the parking lot as there are no meters. We do not have assigned parking, so please be sure to come at least 30 minutes early. 

###Walking Directions:
Once parked cross to the other side of the street on Shelter Island Drive and the path to the docks has yellow markers on the corner. The dock path is located between Intrepid Boat Works and San Diego Marine Exchange. Once on the dock path the boat is located at the second black gate. **Check-in will be directly at the gate.** Please fill out your waivers prior to arrival and have your ID handy! 

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/mUsimS2yRfWJd6Kr1RCH)

Our Charter will not wait for anyone who is late and you will not receive a refund if you do not call before the charter departure informing us that you will not be arriving.

###Cruise Features

COVID-19 Precautions:
The Triton is sanitized before, during, and after every charter. 

## Please Note: 
- This charter will be at 2700 Shelter Island Drive for the San Diego Bay Parade of Lights. This event is NOT in Mission Bay.
- Outside beverages in any type of container must be poured out prior to boarding. We will happily fill it with water once you've boarded.  
- You may bring your own personal snacks
- No smoking, drugs, outside alcohol, or lewd behavior. 
- Any attempt to jump off of the Alana will forfeit your charter and will result in fines under 46 U.S. Code § 2302.
- Your Charter includes a Coast Guard Certified Captain and Crew Members to assist you on your journey. 
- Slide is not available for ticketed charters.
